description: -05 twin of neg-provenance-mode-contemporaneous-orphaned-fields (only spec_version differs): provenance_mode.mode='contemporaneous' carrying a backfilled-only companion field (source_ref present and non-null) -> provenance_mode_invalid (check 9, gating; the orphaned-fields branch, presence-and-non-null). derived.provenance_mode='contemporaneous' is still recorded; no provenance_time_rung cap is derived for a contemporaneous record.

findings.detail: provenance_mode fields ['source_ref'] are meaningful only when mode='backfilled' (§5.3(bis) Provenance mode)
